title.narrative: Women, Coffee and Climate: Women's empowerment for socio-ecological resilience of coffee value chain against climate change in Ethiopia.

description.narrative: The action intends to enhance gender equality and sustainability of Ethiopian coffee value chain through eco-efficiency, social innovation, and south south cooperation. It focuses on T women economic and social empowerment by establishing a nexus between women-coffee-climate.
